reportOnlyUntil: Drew review - no apply is authorized by this PR
rulings: R64 (Drew, 2026-09-18) part (c): the census found THREE mixed 2022 Topps Chrome image-variation partitions. #221 Witt is listed separately (2026-09-18-r64-witt-221-four-cards.json); these are the other two.

BOTH PARTITIONS ARE ALREADY THE RIGHT ADDRESS FOR MOST OF THEIR ROWS. Unlike #221, the partition id here IS a checklist-backed row: `hiq:baseball:2022:topps-chrome:<n>:image-variation:no-auto` is Beckett's `Image Variation SP` for both #128 Cruz and #200 Trout (beckett-scraped-2026-09-01). So the fix is narrow - one row each - not a four-way split.

#128 CRUZ: one row moves. 'ONeil Cruz 2022 Topps Chrome Ben Baller Black Rookie RC #128 SP PSA 10 GEM MINT' ($85, tca-ebay) names the Ben Baller EDITION with Black as its parallel, and pooled with the flagship SP because the title reader could not see the edition - the defect PR #2246 fixes. The two 'Topps Chrome - Variation #128' rows ($154.01, $2.50) state no product word and stay.

#200 TROUT: one row is PARKED, none move. 'Mike Trout 2022 Topps Chrome #200 Image Variation SP Refractor Angels' ($18.26) states an SP AND a refractor finish, and NO catalog row carries that combination for #200. Minting one from a single sale would repeat exactly the #221 SP error this ruling forbids. The other row ('MIKE TROUT Variation #200', $25) states no finish and stays.

THE DESTINATION FOR CRUZ NEEDS MINTING and is NOT minted here: `topps-chrome-ben-baller:128:black` does not exist as a catalog row. Ben Baller's checklist IS held (7,301 checklist-backed rows incl. #128 Refractor Orange/Rose Gold/SuperFractor), so this is a gap in one parallel rather than an unbacked product - but it is still a mint, and mints do not belong in a pool list. Flagged for the catalog lane.
AXIS: setKey and parallel move together as ONE ruled axis. cardNumber, isAuto and every trailing segment carry through byte-identical.

AMENDED 2026-09-18: the Ben Baller entry is PARKED, not relocated. The acquisition asked for was refused - three sources agree 2022 Topps Chrome Ben Baller has no Black parallel, so `topps-chrome-ben-baller:128:black` names a card that does not exist and nothing was staged. `catalogRowsNeededBeforeApply` is now empty: this list mints nothing and needs nothing minted.

entries.title: ONeil Cruz 2022 Topps Chrome Ben Baller Black Rookie RC #128 SP PSA 10 GEM MINT
entries.evidence: PARKED, acquisition REFUSED. The title says 'Ben Baller Black' but THREE sources agree no Black parallel exists in 2022 Topps Chrome Ben Baller: checklistcenter ('There is no BLACK parallel listed'), Cardboard Connection (Green/99, Blue/75, Gold/50, Orange/25, Chartreuse/15, Rose Gold/10, Red/5, SuperFractor 1/1, plus Purple Friends-and-Family /42), and BaseballCardPedia verbatim ('All base cards except the five high-number short-prints are also available in the following parallels. Green Refractor ... Blue Refractor ... Chartreuse Refractor') with no Black, B&W or Black/White variant. Our own catalog agrees: ben-baller #128 holds 16 checklistcenter rows (Base + those 8 parallels), no Black; and topps-chrome-black has ZERO #128 rows, so 'Black' is not naming that product either. Minting a Black row so this sale has somewhere to go would file 85 USD at an address no publisher backs - the error R64b forbids. See backend/docs/acquisition/2026-09-18-ben-baller-128-black.md; if Drew reads 'Black' as describing Ben Baller's black-bordered design, the destination hiq:baseball:2022:topps-chrome-ben-baller:128:base:no-auto already exists, checklist-backed, and this becomes a one-line relocate.

entries.title: Mike Trout 2022 Topps Chrome #200 Image Variation SP Refractor Angels
entries.evidence: PARKED: the title states 'Image Variation SP Refractor' -- an SP AND a refractor finish -- but no catalog row carries that combination for #200. The Beckett row is `Image Variation SP` (no finish) and checklistcenter's are named speckle/superfractor refractors. Absent beats wrong: minting `image-variation-sp-refractor` from one $18.26 sale would repeat the #221 SP error this same ruling forbids.
